{"id":1934377020,"question_id":4161,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772339749,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1934377020/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Bitwise OR From Grid","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumOR(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        unordered_set<int>dp;\n        dp.insert(0);\n\n        for(auto &it : grid){\n            unordered_set<int>nextdp;\n            for(auto prevval : dp){\n                for(auto x : it){\n                    nextdp.insert(prevval | x);\n                }\n            }\n            dp = nextdp;\n        }\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        for(auto it : dp){\n            ans = min(ans, it);\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-bitwise-or-from-grid","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1760}
